parameters.query: SELECT id, nome, duracao_minutos, preco FROM servicos WHERE tenant_id = $1 ORDER BY nome;
SELECT p.id, p.nome FROM profissionais p JOIN profissionais_servicos ps ON ps.profissional_id = p.id WHERE ps.servico_id = $1 ORDER BY p.nome;

SELECT a.data_hora, s.duracao_minutos FROM agendamentos a JOIN servicos s ON s.id = a.servico_id WHERE a.profissional_id = $1 AND a.status = 'confirmado' AND a.data_hora::date = $2::date ORDER BY a.data_hora;

parameters.query:
WITH cli AS (
  INSERT INTO clientes (tenant_id, nome, telefone)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
  ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, telefone) DO UPDATE SET nome = COALESCE(clientes.nome, EXCLUDED.nome)
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO agendamentos (tenant_id, cliente_id, profissional_id, servico_id, data_hora)
SELECT $1, cli.id, $4, $5, (($6 || ' ' || $7)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')
FROM cli
RETURNING id, data_hora;
